answer: Twenty-four prisms open each epoch in walnut mounts, for twenty minutes. A claimant refracts a block-seeded beam into eight colors, each seeded by the block and the color before, onto a sable cloth, signed by three strangers, two each. Entry locks 90 POA, +55 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 3,375 POA. One operator tends two at most: ten fakes need five hands, ten refractions, thirty signatures from fifteen strangers. A missed color burns 30; one spectrum at two prisms voids both bonds. The ledger matches times to funding roots: ten spectra, one root, one claim.
